spans.s:
झष् {c1c} U. (झषति-ते)
1 To take.
--2 To put on, wear.
--3 To hurt or
kill (only P. in this sense).

1 A fish in general; झषाणां
मकरश्चास्मि

; cf. words
like झषकेतन below.
--2 A large fish.
--3 The sign Pisces of the zodiac.
--4 Heat, warmth.
--5 The sign
Capricornus of the zodiac.
--षं
1 A
forest, wood.
--2 A desert, dreary
forest.
--Comp.
--अंकः, --केतनः, --केतुः,
--ध्वजः N. of the god of love;
स्त्रीमुद्रां झषकेतनस्य

.
--अशनः
a porpoise.
--उदरी an epithet of
Satyavatī, mother of Vyāsa.
